case_id: # Case cards written from the WHO IMCI Chart Booklet (March 2014) ASSESS & CLASSIFY chart for

# classification(s) the booklet gives. Cards were written from the chart rows before the engine
# output was looked at; see cases/README.md for provenance and for the sign vocabulary.
# expected lists every classification the booklet assigns separated by | ; - means none.
# The no-finding rows NO EAR INFECTION and NO ACUTE MALNUTRITION record absence rather than an
# action and are excluded from the comparison on both sides (stated in Section 6.6).
